mapper.sql: d.id, d.post_id, d.student_id, d.academic_term, d.reason, d.evidence, d.status, d.interview_result, d.interview_note, d.applied_at, d.hired_at, d.resign_reason, d.note, d.created_at, d.updated_at, d.deleted, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.real_name, ''), u.nickname, u.username) AS student_name, COALESCE(sp.student_no, u.student_id) AS student_no, COALESCE(sp.class_name, u.class_name) AS class_name, CASE WHEN sp.family_income_level IS NOT NULL AND sp.family_income_level <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS poverty, p.name AS post_name, p.unit AS unit, p.post_type AS post_type, p.hourly_wage AS hourly_wage

FROM workstudy_application d LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = d.student_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_profile sp ON sp.user_id = d.student_id AND sp.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN workstudy_post p ON p.id = d.post_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workstudy_application (post_id, student_id, academic_term, reason, evidence, status, applied_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted) VALUES (#{postId}, #{studentId}, #{academicTerm}, #{reason}, #{evidence}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*)
WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND d.student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE workstudy_application SET resign_reason = #{reason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT d.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM workstudy_application d LEFT JOIN workstudy_post p ON p.id = d.post_id WHERE d.deleted = 0 AND p.unit_user_id = #{unitUserId} AND d.academic_term = #{academicTerm} GROUP BY d.status
